name: anystream
description: AnyStream: a Netflix-style Jellyfin and Plex client for Fire TV. packages/core is shared; apps/vega (Vega OS) and apps/fireos (Fire OS, Android TV) are the device shells.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @anystream/core && npm run typecheck -w @anystream/vega

vegaDependencies.@amazon-devices/react-native-w3cmedia: see README step 3 (version must match your generated project)
vegaDependencies.@amazon-devices/keplercrypto: 2.1.4-rn-83 (secure random source for the Plex signing key)
